sections.description: Scans your WordPress site for GDPR, NIS2, DORA, and EAA compliance gaps. Free checks: SSL, cookies, forms, backups, plugin health, legal pages. Pro ($79/year per website) unlocks editable HTML DPA, NIS2/DORA and EAA starters, an HTML report from the latest scan with recorded history, and a scan every day on your own WordPress server instead of once a week.
sections.changelog:
= 1.3.9 (2026-09-26) =
* Pro: the compliance report now states the interval the site is actually scheduled for, so the document a client reads says how often it was checked.
* The line follows WP-Cron, not the licence: a released, expired or out-of-slots licence puts it back to saying once a week.

= 1.3.8 (2026-09-26) =
* Pro: the scheduled job on your own WordPress server now runs once a day instead of once a week. The six checks are local, so the extra runs cost the site nothing and need no external service.
* The free version keeps its weekly run, and the interval follows the licence in both directions: released, expired or out of device slots all go back to weekly.
* The dashboard states the interval the site is actually scheduled for, and a changed interval re-schedules from now instead of a full interval later.

= 1.3.7 (2026-09-26) =
* Pro: the compliance report can be downloaded from wp-admin without creating a client link, so an agency that attaches it every month no longer has to issue a new 30-day link each time.
* The download is the same document as the one a client link serves — same report, same scan history, same filename — and it is now the only rendering of the report in the plugin.
* The download requires the same account permission, nonce and active Pro licence as every other screen in wp-admin, and a refused download returns no document and no filename.
* Every screen and export in the plugin is gated on one declared capability, so a download can never be reached more loosely than the settings page.

= 1.3.6 =
* The client report can be downloaded as a file, next to a freshly created link, so an agency can attach it to an e-mail or hand it to an auditor.
* The file is the same report as the page, scan history included.
* The filename is eucomply-report-<date>.html and carries no part of the link.
* A download without a valid link returns the same "not found" page as the report.

= 1.3.3 =
* The accessibility statement now carries the known-limitations and enforcement-body elements of Article 13(2) of Directive (EU) 2019/882.
* The statement ships a working contact address when one is set in Settings, and a field to complete when it is not. It never contains a broken contact link.
* Every generated document lists the fields to complete, read from the document itself.

= 1.3.2 =
* A device-limit response (HTTP 409) no longer locks your license; the settings screen explains it and can free the slot.
* New "Release this device" action, so a Pro license can be moved to another website.
* License-server errors (402, 429, 5xx, network) keep a verified Pro status for 7 days.
* The Pro report names warnings separately instead of counting them as plain passes.

= 1.3.1 =
* Pro copy now describes the actual HTML report instead of a PDF report.
* Pro users can download the HTML report directly from the scan results.
* The update package and manifest point to version 1.3.1.

= 1.3.0 =
* Pro licenses are sold through Stripe and checked against the Mahope license server (mahope.tools); keys are 32 hex characters.
* First check activates the site, daily checks validate it.
* A verified Pro status is kept for 7 days if the license server is unreachable.

= 1.2.0 =
* Activation guard for PHP/WordPress versions.
* URL fixes, ZIP rebuilt with correct plugin header.

= 1.1.0 =
* License API (former Lemon Squeezy) integration with caching and refund detection.
* Auto-update checker via update.json manifest.
* Improved license validation UX in settings.

= 1.0.0 =
* Initial release.
* Six compliance checks: SSL, cookies, forms, backups, plugins, legal pages.
* Weekly automated re-scan via WP-Cron.
* AJAX scan from admin dashboard.
* Pro license system with document generation.
